notes.title: v1.15
notes.content:
fixed German localization
 achievements are now translated into German
 fixed wrong words during cutscene in Japanese
 fixed that that icon for crit change wasn't showing for some languages
 fixed gap on Portal 6 that allowed to go outside the map

notes.title: v 1.14
notes.content: fixed clipping through wall and floor upon death after upgrading to armor level 5

notes.title: v 1.13
notes.content:
- fixed that quest on upgrading armor appear even if a player bought all the levels (bug occurred after last fix)
- fixed collision of the floor in th Main Hall making the play stand in the air in some areas

notes.title: v 1.12
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36255032/74c159d08cd8b4fc6213861711cce5779b1b69c3.png

  fixed that empty hint box appeared on the screen in multyplayer when players are far from each other or returning from portal
  fixed bug when part of client player damage could be taken from host player
  fixed that if client died and the host left the game without revining then if client tried to play the game he remained dead when starting new game untill restarting the whole game
  fixed that if host dies and the client left the game without reviving the host remained dead forever
  fixed that quality settings applied twice
  fixed if one of the players died in portal 6 in the trap room with exit portal in it when the other is outside it then there was no way to complete the level
  fixed that revival didn't cancel when player released the button
  rewrote revival and now player will have 2 sec of invulnerability after revival
  fixed network problem with ragdoll when dead in multiplayer
  added players names to the pause menu in multiplayer when in the main hall (not in portals)
  added cutscene to the Cemetry secret
  added skin to armor level 5
  removed armor levels from 6 and further
  improved start loading time of the game

notes.title: v1.11
notes.content:
jump was changed
 fixed that leeches spawnуed one in another and stuck in the air in portals 17-18

notes.title: v 1.10
notes.content:
fixed cupboards in the walls in portal 7
 removed stone that prevented smooth walking in portal 3
 fixed that an item with a key could spawn not on the floor (above door arc) in portal 2
 there won't be hints about entering the portals if the portal is not active
 in portals 17-18 additional enemies will be spawn if you haven't finished the necessary amount yet
 fixed that achievement "I know them all" could granted without 1 enemy
 in portal 6 fixed that bargests at the far end of the Cemetery couldn't chase you
 fixed that damage didn't apply to the objects right before the player
 rebalanced weapon price

notes.title: v1.9
notes.content:
game was upgraded to unreal engine version 4.27
 fixed localization issues
 fixed that the chest after killing Rat Queen didn't unload after exiting the portal
 fixed that currency wasn't updated in the UI in the next portal after the item purchase
 removed running option - now character is always in running state
 changed Lizard animation when hitted
 part of the save (the one that is happening during gameplay) now executed asynchronously

notes.title: Patch 1.8
notes.content:
fixed that you could lose the key in portal 7 if you try to open an already opened door
 replaced wrong undestroyable chest in portal 7
 fixed looping Barghest death animation that made him die several times
 added text to explain the icons in upgrade windows

notes.title: Patch 1.7
notes.content:
fixed that japanese hieroglyphs wasn't displayed during start cutscene 
 fixed that armor materials sometimes didn't properly displayed when updating

notes.title: Update 1.6
notes.content:
Added spanish localization.
Special thanks to @Klumb3r

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
fixed holes on portal 1
  fixed items in the air in portal 6
  fixed that some items from portal 4 wasn't unloaded after returning to the Main Hall and could be seen and destroyed on other portals
  fixed visual noise in trees of the Dark Forest (portals 5-7) due to last LODs
  fixed enemy type for leech (didn't affect gameplay only visuals)
  added new challenges types (clear specific portal, destroy specific item and enemy)
  adjusted AI of Juggernauts (portals 14-15) and spiders
  now if you die when returned to the main hall your health will be half from maximum instead of full
  reduced build size on 300Mb

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.content:
fixed that it was unable (until restart of the game) for clients to join a previous session if they just exit to menu and try to join 
  fixed that if you get an invite when the game wasn't launched you couldn't join. Now joining will be performed after the start cutscene
  fixed that clients could see damage on opened chests
  number of enemies in portal 2 were slightly increased
  two webs that were just decorations in portal 2 now can be destroyed
  fixed the landscape in portal 3 that was a little bit "alive" due to LODs

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
now hide HUD option is fires only to the gameplay and not all the hud
  fixed visual bug that next portal was not highlighted if you died on previous portal and then completed it
  fixed enemies sound sometimes didn't load from save
  fixed postprocess in treasure room in portal 15
  fixed that the chest after Spider boss could spawned in wrong place
  fixed the key in portal 7 that was half in the ground
  adjusted the amount of repeated tiles in portal 9
  rebalanced high-level portals enemies
  other minor improvements

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.content:
fixed zero reward in challenges (you will have to refresh them)
  fixed torch in the air in portal 7
  fixed holes in portals 3, 17
  fixed client seen prisoners icons as it they were players
  rebalanced weapon cost

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
Thanks to your feedback we've made bunch of improvement and fixed to the v1:


 fixed that some enemies didn't unload when returning to the Main Hall when you die
 fixed opened chests were showing the damage amount making you feel that you are able to destroy it
 fixed that it was possible to return to the Lobby without completing the dungeon
 fixed holes in the dungeon portal #20
 fixed missing sound of some enemies
 added volume for enemy sounds
 mouse sensitivity default value was decreased and now the default value is 40%
 challenges rewards are now calculated based on number of times you need to did the task
 upgrade terminals ui now contains information about level and experience points
